			<h4 class="uppercase text-center">lion hostel tarifa</h4>
			<ul class="nav nav-tabs nav-uppercase nav-size-normal nav-center" role="tablist"><li id="tab-hostel-description" class="tab active has-icon" role="presentation"><a href="#tab_hostel-description" role="tab" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="tab_hostel-description"><span>Hostel description</span></a></li>

<div class="row"  id="row-256262580">
	<div id="col-1376559289" class="col medium-7 small-12 large-7"  >
				<div class="col-inner"  >
<h2 class="uppercase"><strong>Lion hostel tarifa</strong></h2>
<p>Lion Hostel Tarifa by Rebels is located in the historical center of the city, right in front of the monument Puerta de Jerez, and few minutes walk from the main beaches, restaurants and shopping area.<br />
The Hostel breaks into an old house of the nineteenth century, enlarged and renovated. It has a delicated architecture within a modern Hostel, in which the art coexists with the confort from nowadays.<br />
Tarifa Hostel is focused on those guests who are looking for an exclusive accommodation as well as an economic trip.<br />
At the Hostel’s solarium, there is a bar service, where customers can sunbathe, have a refreshing shower and chill with a cocktail while admiring the sunset over the breathtaking views of Morocco.</p>
<a rel="noopener noreferrer" href="#contact" target="_blank" class="button primary box-shadow-3 box-shadow-1-hover"  style="border-radius:5px;">
    <span>Contact us</span>
  </a>
		</div>
					</div>

<h3 class="uppercase"><strong>Tarifa Hostel Rooms</strong></h3>
<p>Lion Hostel Tarifa stands out among a selection of accommodations for its spacious rooms with high ceilings and decorated. It offers all the amenities so that guest can enjoy a unique stay. An authentic &#8220;Rebels Tarifa experience&#8221; that will make your stay an unforgettable experience.<br />
Our Hostel is distributed in three rooms of ten guests each, where you can enjoy a rest in harmony, and for those who prefer more privacy, we have two rooms of four guest each.</p>

<h3 class="uppercase"><strong>Services and facilities at the Hotel</strong></h3>
<p>Lion Hostel Tarifa offers a high variety of services to all our guest. Our staff will show you happily the activities and services we provide.</p>
<ul>
<li>Panoramic 360º solárium with Views to Morocco and the coast of Spain.</li>
<li>A bar only for our guest.</li>
<li>A dining room where our guest can meet.</li>
<li>Free WIFI</li>
<li>Kitchen</li>
<li>Towel with a 5 euros deposit that will be returned once you give it back.</li>
<li>Payment in cash, credit card and debit card.</li>
<li>Rooms with facilities for people with reduced mobility</li>
<li>Express Check In and Check Out.</li>
<li>Reception service to ask for activities, sports, tourism, cultural and transport information as well as restaurants.</li>
<li>Family options: Room for 4 people.</li>
<li>Optional Laundry services for long stays.</li>
<li>Happy Hours at our bar located in the Solarium.</li>
<li>Transport services.</li>
<li>Lunch and picnic to take away.</li>
<li>Bicycle rental, Surfboards, SUP and Longboard.<br />
Kitesurfing lessons, Surf lessons and SUP.</li>
<li>Private trunk/cabinetwith locker for your stuff.</li>
</ul>

<div class="container section-title-container" style="margin-top:25px;"><h3 class="section-title section-title-center"><b></b><span class="section-title-main" >FAQS</span><b></b></h3></div>
<div class="row"  id="row-260630270">
	<div id="col-163500146" class="col small-12 large-12"  >
				<div class="col-inner" style="background-color:rgb(218, 224, 239);" >
<div class="accordion">
<div id="accordion-1395105621" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-1395105621-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-1395105621-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>What is a Hostel?</span></a><div id="accordion-1395105621-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-1395105621-label">
<p>A Hostel is an economic accommodation where you can share new experiences. For this reason, Lion Hostel Tarifa offers you the best services of a Hotel, at a lower price.</p>
</div></div>
<div id="accordion-1902573909" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-1902573909-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-1902573909-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>What do I need to bring at the hostel?</span></a><div id="accordion-1902573909-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-1902573909-label">
<p>Lion Hostel Tarifa offers you a very complete lodging service. You only have to take into account your personal belongings, as once you are here, we will offer you all the services you need.</p>
</div></div>
<div id="accordion-1548455431" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-1548455431-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-1548455431-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>Check in and check out schedules</span></a><div id="accordion-1548455431-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-1548455431-label">
<p>At Lion Hostel Tarifa we like to offer a flexible time which is about 24 h. However, it will depends on the season, therefore, it would be better if you ask us directly.<br />
Just bare in mind we love to respect our guest’s sleep hours and it is important that we all respect those hours in silence.</p>
</div></div>
<div id="accordion-2049411568" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-2049411568-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-2049411568-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>What kind of security offers the hostel?</span></a><div id="accordion-2049411568-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-2049411568-label">
<p>EWe are facing the ultimate in security, with surveillance cameras in the common areas connected 24/7 by telephone, as well as professional staff, emergency exit and lights and extinguishers.</p>
</div></div>
<div id="accordion-3962230812" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-3962230812-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-3962230812-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>Is it wheelchair-enabled or/and other functionally diverse?</span></a><div id="accordion-3962230812-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-3962230812-label">
<p>Indeed We have easy access to the bedroom, bathroom and other common areas.</p>
</div></div>
<div id="accordion-432765765" class="accordion-item"><a id="accordion-432765765-label" href="#" class="accordion-title plain" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="accordion-432765765-content"><button class="toggle" aria-label="Toggle"><i class="icon-angle-down"></i></button><span>Cancellation policy</span></a><div id="accordion-432765765-content" class="accordion-inner" aria-labelledby="accordion-432765765-label">
<p>In case you need to cancel your booking, you have to let Lion Hostel Tarifa know through phone or email at least 72 hours before your arrival. Otherwise you will be charged for the 100% of your booking.</p>
</div></div>
</div>
		</div>
					</div>
